name: Ruru's Love Capsule
source:
Rei, a Japanese worker, lives quietly until he meets Ruzhitsa, a visiting Serbian. Her innocence and warmth are impossible to resist.

She lingers nearby, attentive to every word, her world revolving around him. Love – or something more dangerous?

[From [url=https://golozhopiki-corporation.itch.io/capsula]Itch.io[/url]]
